## About
Import Auto was started as a low pressure, economical alternative to traditional dealer service. We focus on Toyota, Lexus and Scion vehicles, and our team is trained in Toyota service and ASE certified.
We use and prefer original equipment Toyota parts. When you're keeping an older car going, there may be a more economical option, and we'll talk it through with you before any work is done.
You'll find us at 2200 Lemay Ferry Road in St. Louis. Call ahead for an appointment, or use our early bird key drop if your morning is already full.

## Services
- Scheduled maintenance: Preventive maintenance at the mileage intervals your owner's manual recommends.
- Safety and emissions inspections: Safety and emissions inspections for your vehicle.
- Check engine light and repairs: We can diagnose your check engine light and handle your Toyota, Lexus and Scion repairs. Estimates are free.
- Brakes: Pads, shoes, discs, drums, calipers, master cylinders, lines and fluid.
- Steering and suspension: Shocks, struts, springs, tires, wheels, ball joints, tie rods, control arms, racks, pumps and hoses.
- Tune-ups: Spark plugs, ignition, wires, coils, distributor, timing, throttle body and injector services.
- Transmission: Fluid checks, filters, gaskets, flushes, repairs and replacements.
- Coolant system: Fluid checks, flushes, hoses, pumps, belts, radiators and heater cores.
- Air conditioning and heating: Refrigerant checks, compressors, evaporators, condensers, lines and controls.
- Starting and charging: Batteries, cables, alternators, starters, belts and wiring.
- Pre-owned vehicles: A select inventory of pre-owned vehicles, and help locating a particular car if you're looking for one.

## FAQ
Q: Can I drop my car off before you open?
A: Yes. Early bird envelopes are at the front door. Fill out your contact information, put your key inside and slip it through the drop off slot in the door.

Q: Do you use original Toyota parts?
A: We use and prefer original equipment Toyota parts. For an aging vehicle, economical alternatives may make sense, and we'll discuss those options with you.

Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No. Estimates are free.

Q: What if I need a tow?
A: For emergency towing, call 314-422-9229.
